messages:
mike: Heads up — scheduling a night push for midnight UTC to apply a kernel compatibility pin on Dedicated EU clusters (00:00-02:00 UTC). This is an SLA-exception window because the new kernel causes a perf regression for some quantized runtimes. Need approval for customer comms + statuspage snippet.

alice: Ack. Can you confirm scope (which customers / clusters)?

tara: Scope: dedicated-eu-1, dedicated-eu-2, and any reserved-capacity tenants with >4 GPUs in EU. Hosted customers unaffected. I'll draft comms.

sara: I'll prep monitoring + add temporary alert sensitivity. Will watch CPU/GPU latency, queue length, and token-per-sec.

mike: Plan: canary at 23:30 UTC on dedicated-eu-1 (single pool), hold for 30m. If OK, full rollout at 00:00 with 15m staged holds per pool. Rollback path: pin back to v3.2.1 and revert kernel flag; ETA to revert ~20m. Deploy-bot will post status updates.

deploy-bot: Canary job created: deploy/canary/dedicated-eu-1@23:30 -> image: infra/pin-2023q4, config: keep-kv-cache=true. Full rollout job queued with staged holds: 15m per pool.

statuspage-bot: Suggested statuspage snippet: ```We are performing a scheduled maintenance on Dedicated EU clusters from 00:00-02:00 UTC to apply a compatibility pin. Some dedicated tenants may experience brief increased latency or failover while we validate the rollout. Hosted API customers are not affected. We'll post updates here and on status.redwood.com.```

tara: Draft customer email (short): ```Subject: Night maintenance: Dedicated EU pinned update (00:00-02:00 UTC) Hi — We will apply a compatibility pin to Dedicated EU clusters tonight to address a kernel/model interaction. Impact: short-lived latency spikes or transient errors for some dedicated tenants. No action required. If you rely on strict latency SLOs during the window, reply and we'll discuss scheduling alternatives. --Support Team```

alice: LGTM. Add a line for SLA exception and who to contact for incident escalation (oncall@mredwood.com).

sara: I'll add Grafana dashboards to the rollout playbook and set an automated rollback trigger: sustained p95 latency > 300ms for 5m or error rate > 1% for 10m.

mike: Perfect. Tara, can you schedule the statuspage update to go live at 23:45 UTC with a short note and link to the customer email? Also please send the customer email at 22:00 UTC to give ops time to react.

tara: Will do. Sending draft to #support-review at 21:30 for quick sign-off.

mike: Thanks everyone. If anything looks off during canary we hold and rollback. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary started at 23:30 UTC (dedicated-eu-1). Will post progress messages: canary-ok / canary-fail.
